name: Verify source links
description: Check citation URLs, fixed presentation links and optional literal output-format contracts; not a factual-accuracy guarantee.
value: Check citation URLs, fixed presentation links and optional literal output-format contracts; not a factual-accuracy guarantee.

draft.notes: Text or {text}, at most 16000 characters. Markdown link targets are read exactly; bare URLs are read from the remaining text.

language.notes: uk checks Ukrainian text markers; not a language-quality or fact-check guarantee.

fixedLinks.notes: JSON array of fixed HTTP(S) presentation links (for example a fixed header) allowed in addition to selected-source URLs. Every other link must be a selected source, and every selected source must still be cited. May use {{env.NAME}}; an unresolved placeholder fails.

requiredPrefix.notes: Byte-exact literal prefix the draft must begin with, checked before any approval gate. May use {{env.NAME}}; an unresolved placeholder fails.

requiredHeadings.notes: JSON array of exact level-two Markdown headings. When set, the draft must contain exactly these ## headings in this order, each with nonempty content; ### sub-headings are allowed.

result.notes: {text, artifactHash, sourceHash, fixedLinks?, checks, limitation}. Checks selected citation URLs, optional fixed links and optional literal format contracts; not a factual-accuracy guarantee.

implementation.limitation: Candidate generic Registry route evidence; it is not public or user acceptance.

acceptance.scope: Controlled local installed Registry candidate run; this evidence is not public-release or owner acceptance.
